Hmm, the loop exceeded the 180s bash tool limit (each round spawns main.py which rebuilds the Rust project every time — ~2-3s per invocation! That's the bottleneck). Better: run the engine once per batch — main.py accepts one request with multiple sessions! I can batch many sessions per request (up to 16). Let me restructure: generate 16 sessions per request, one engine call, compare all.

Also the engine binary could be called directly with the word-stream... but the word format is main.py's internal transport. Simpler: batch sessions (≤16 per request) and keep the request within bounds (work bound is fine for small cases).

Let me restructure ref_check to group sessions in batches of 16.
